dogecoin.text: Dogecoin is facing a sharp decline in market cap, highlighting the asset’s volatility. The meme-based crypto lost about $13.47 billion in just three hours as it  plunged to $79 bn from $92 bn . At $0.67 price from the $0.73 all-time high price on May 8th.

The American Cancer Society (ACS) has announced that they now accept Dogecoin for all kinds of donations. Thus, donors can send DOGE and other already supported coins to the ACS. ACS is intending to raise $1 million for its crypto cancer fund this year.
